cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.19)
project(boolean_balance LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
get_filename_component(MOCKTURTLE_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../mockturtle" ABSOLUTE)
set(MOCKTURTLE_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MOCKTURTLE_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(MOCKTURTLE_BUILD_EXPERIMENTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
if(NOT EXISTS "${MOCKTURTLE_SOURCE_DIR}/include/mockturtle/algorithms/balancing.hpp")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Initialize the pinned standalone mockturtle submodule first")
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${MOCKTURTLE_SOURCE_DIR}" rev-parse HEAD
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE MT_REVISION OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
if(NOT MT_REVISION STREQUAL "1c9c3af6a423f650f654ccec340dae9b93995844")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected standalone mockturtle revision: ${MT_REVISION}")
endif()
execute_process(COMMAND git -C "${MOCKTURTLE_SOURCE_DIR}" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no
  OUTPUT_VARIABLE MT_DIRTY OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE COMMAND_ERROR_IS_FATAL ANY)
if(MT_DIRTY)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Refusing to build balancing against modified dependency sources")
endif()
add_subdirectory("${MOCKTURTLE_SOURCE_DIR}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mockturtle")
add_executable(boolean_balance main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(boolean_balance PRIVATE mockturtle)
file(SHA256 "${MOCKTURTLE_SOURCE_DIR}/include/mockturtle/algorithms/balancing.hpp" BALANCING_SHA)
file(SHA256 "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/main.cpp" TOOL_SHA)
file(WRITE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/build_provenance.json"
  "{\n  \"mockturtle_revision\": \"${MT_REVISION}\",\n  \"balancing_header_sha256\": \"${BALANCING_SHA}\",\n  \"tool_source_sha256\": \"${TOOL_SHA}\",\n  \"compiler\": \"${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID} ${CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_VERSION}\",\n  \"dependency_sources_clean\": true\n}\n")
